title: Operation Castle sailors see discs over ships

plain: A researcher named Robert Hastings, who gathers accounts of UFOs near nuclear sites, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Operation Castle, a series of US nuclear bomb tests in the Marshall Islands in the Pacific in 1954. He says he found sailors on several ships who described brief but clear sightings of disc shaped or round objects hovering over their vessels. If true, it would suggest UFOs were taking an interest in nuclear weapons tests.
